_source: Original photographs for the 7 non-target regression cases (test_images_6 screenshots), supplied by Nordine 2026-09-04, + 2 extra non-target photos.

_note: Verdicts on the CURRENT build (judge V1.14 / prompts V2.6) are in `observed_*`. `expected_verdict` is the target after the fix. `prohibited_verdicts` is the hard constraint. C7_9 ground truth needs client confirmation.

cases.subject: Paper wasp (Polistes) on its nest. The nest is an OPEN single hexagonal comb with no envelope — structurally impossible for Vespa velutina (enclosed carton). Insect soft/backlit, nest sharp.
cases.observed_motif: Q1 + Q2 + Q3 = OUI valides sur le meme individu.
cases.note: CRITICAL. Symmetrical exclusion gate (nest = open comb) must fire before the ROUGE short-circuit.

cases.subject: Wasp on tree bark, 4+ regular yellow bands across the abdomen, yellow legs, dark thorax with yellow shoulders. Readable.
Wasp on a purple globe thistle, regular yellow bands, reddish legs. Sharp on the insect, outdoor daylight.
Volucella hoverfly (a FLY, hornet mimic) on mint flowers — huge eyes, single pair of wings, no wasp waist. Very sharp, full sun.
Volucella hoverfly on a white flower. Very sharp, full sun.
Volucella hoverfly on a white flower. Very sharp, full sun.
European hornet (Vespa crabro), dead on its side — yellow abdomen with dark teardrop marks, reddish-brown thorax and head. Sharp.
Paper wasp (Polistes) on white umbel flowers — dark body with yellow markings, thin yellow bands, long dangling legs, narrow waist. Sharp, daylight.
Small/distant insect on a horizontal branch, foliage background, low resolution. Orange/dark. Genuinely hard — could be a distant Asian hornet or a wasp.
cases.note: Ground truth UNCONFIRMED — ask the client. If a distant Asian hornet: a retake (RETAKE_MORPHOLOGY / distance) is the correct fail-safe here, not a wrong verdict.
